## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance
- [ ] Performance-related change
- [ ] Research / reproducibility update

## Validation

Describe how the change was validated. Include relevant tests, commands, or CI results.

- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests where appropriate
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed

## Correctness and compatibility

Describe any impact on algorithm semantics, public APIs, storage formats, reproducibility, or backward compatibility.

## Performance / benchmark impact

If this PR changes performance-sensitive behavior, provide reproducible evidence and clearly state the timing/correctness contract. Do not make unsupported speed claims.

If it does not affect performance or benchmark evidence, state: **No benchmark impact.**

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable
- [ ] No secrets, proprietary data, PII, or credentials are included
- [ ] Relevant documentation and release notes are updated when necessary
- [ ] Research claims, if any, are scoped to retained evidence
